correctness.rationale: The explicitly specified graphs have verified (16,6,2,2) structure. After two occupied nonneighbors exactly four vertices remain; their 9 residual cases are C4 throughout the rook graph and 3 C4 plus 6 diamonds for Shrikhande. Uniform accepted-order probabilities then give the complete terminal labeled-set laws. For finite time, independent first-attempt indicators yield a Bernstein expansion whose 17 exact rational coefficients are computed by a well-founded recurrence on every subset. The table has zeros for k<=3 and strictly positive values for 4<=k<=16. Both separate standalone verifiers were replayed and their independent critical checks passed. No sampling or infinite-time extrapolation substitutes for the exact proof.

value.rationale: Short-cycle correlations are crucial for irreversible adsorption yet are not represented by degree/common-neighbor spectral data. This canonical pair has exactly identical strongly regular parameters but different full terminal laws, with a full-time strict kinetic expected-coverage separation first visible at fourth order. The finite 16-site example supplies a complete benchmark for distinguishing local versus kinetic network invariants, including a per-state distribution and exact dynamic comparison, not an arbitrary single computational number.
